captions.detailed: This object is a model of a jeweler's bench lamp with a dark grey or black clamp-on desk base. It features a silver cylindrical post supporting a long, dual-rail articulated arm with black sliding and pivoting brackets. At the end of the arm is a beige/off-white circular magnifying lamp head containing a light-blue tinted circular lens. The arm and lamp head can pivot up and down via revolute joints to adjust the height and angle of the light.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for an articulated jeweler's magnifying bench lamp. It should feature a black C-clamp base, a vertical silver post, a two-part adjustable parallel-rail arm, and a circular magnifying lamp head with a semi-transparent blue lens, connected by functional revolute joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs the lamp using primitive shapes and transformations. The base clamp is built using box extrusions and cylinders for the screw mechanism. The vertical post is a cylinder, while the parallel-rail arm segments are constructed from pairs of long, thin rectangular boxes connected by sliding blocks. The magnifying lamp head is created using a hollowed-out cylinder (ring) for the frame, joined to a thin cylinder with a glass-like material for the lens, all assembled with revolute joint definitions at the elbow and head attachments.
